cc:Work.dc:title: 07-single-pallet-eight-second-capacity
cc:Work.dc:description: Primary capacity comparison from newly executed alps-claude-capacity-8s/1 artifact: 72-box arrivals, one 1200x1000x1200 mm pallet, five algorithms, selection seeds 410-412, holdout seeds 2410-2414, 8000ms per planner call. Not the 24-box full-order/store model.
